result.description: The Virelli AeroMesh Slate 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for design studios and everyday office work. It features a QHD IPS panel, 144Hz refresh support, adaptive sync, a matte anti-glare finish, and a fully adjustable stand with USB-C input and 65W power delivery. The slim bezel chassis and built-in blue-light filter make it a practical display for mixed productivity and light creative use.
